card.name: Search log fields before IP
card.fires_on: Commas, 'the' and 'including' in lists of fields logged for search queries (query, time, referer, results), where a user's IP address could come next.

modes.label: List punctuation in log fields
modes.description: Commas inside a list of columns or items recorded in a search log.
modes.example: INSERT INTO search_log (time, q, referer<<,>> results) VALUES ('*generate date stamp

modes.label: Linking words in logged-data lists
modes.description: 'the' or 'including' introducing the next logged item in a sentence.
modes.example: we include the query,<< the>> time of the query, the referring page

card.writes: It promotes 'IP' tokens, suggesting an IP address may be the next logged field.
card.plain: It fires in lists of data saved from website searches, where an IP address is a likely next item.
